<Event xmlns='http://schemas.microsoft.com/win/2004/08/events/event'><System><Provider Name='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell' Guid='{a0c1853b-5c40-4b15-8766-3cf1c58f985a}'/><EventID>4104</EventID><Version>1</Version><Level>5</Level><Task>2</Task><Opcode>15</Opcode><Keywords>0x0</Keywords><TimeCreated SystemTime='2026-04-26T14:59:29.4386985Z'/><EventRecordID>690</EventRecordID><Correlation ActivityID='{201bcaf3-d5f1-0003-fcd0-1b20f1d5dc01}'/><Execution ProcessID='8292' ThreadID='8452'/><Channel>Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational</Channel><Computer>DESKTOP-AK0R2QL</Computer><Security UserID='S-1-5-21-1419731445-3156843934-2716133192-1001'/></System><EventData><Data Name='MessageNumber'>1</Data><Data Name='MessageTotal'>1</Data><Data Name='ScriptBlockText'>$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$baseDir = "C:\LabLogs\Endpoint\RansomSim7"
$processLog = "C:\LabLogs\Endpoint\ticket7_process_activity.log"
$fileLog = "C:\LabLogs\Endpoint\ticket7_file_activity.log"
$artifactLog = "C:\LabLogs\Endpoint\ticket7_artifact_activity.log"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $baseDir -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $processLog) -Force | Out-Null

foreach ($log in @($processLog, $fileLog, $artifactLog)) {
    if (Test-Path $log) {
        Remove-Item $log -Force
    }
}

$user = "m.chen@company.local"
$hostName = $env:COMPUTERNAME
$processName = "invoice_viewer.exe"
$parentProcess = "explorer.exe"
$fakePid = Get-Random -Minimum 4000 -Maximum 9000
$ransomExtension = ".lockedx"
$ransomNote = "README_RESTORE_FILES.txt"

$files = @(
    "Q1_Budget.xlsx",
    "Payroll_Review.xlsx",
    "HR_Notes.docx",
    "Vendor_Contracts.docx",
    "Legal_Summary.pdf",
    "Project_Roadmap.pptx",
    "Client_List.csv",
    "Board_Minutes.docx",
    "Finance_Archive.xlsx",
    "Mergers_Notes.txt",
    "Tax_Workpapers.xlsx",
    "Insurance_Details.pdf"
)

function Write-FlatLog {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Line
    )

    $Line | Out-File -FilePath $Path -Append -Encoding utf8
}

foreach ($name in $files) {
    $fullPath = Join-Path $baseDir $name
    "Sample content for $name" | Set-Content -Path $fullPath -Encoding UTF8
}

$ts = (Get-Date).ToString("s")
Write-FlatLog -Path $processLog -Line "timestamp=$ts host=$hostName user=$user process=$processName parent=$parentProcess pid=$fakePid event_type=process_start cmdline=`"$processName /open local_invoice_batch.tmp`""

Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300

foreach ($name in $files) {
    $oldPath = Join-Path $baseDir $name
    $newName = "$name$ransomExtension"
    $newPath = Join-Path $baseDir $newName

    Rename-Item -Path $oldPath -NewName $newName

    $ts = (Get-Date).ToString("s")
    Write-FlatLog -Path $fileLog -Line "timestamp=$ts host=$hostName pid=$fakePid event_type=file_rename action=rename original=`"$oldPath`" new=`"$newPath`""
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 80
}

$notePath = Join-Path $baseDir $ransomNote
$noteContent = @(
    "Your files have been encrypted."
    "Contact: secure_restore@protonmail.com"
    "Reference ID: 7A-441"
)
$noteContent | Set-Content -Path $notePath -Encoding UTF8

$ts = (Get-Date).ToString("s")
Write-FlatLog -Path $artifactLog -Line "timestamp=$ts host=$hostName pid=$fakePid event_type=file_create path=`"$notePath`" file_name=$ransomNote"

Write-Host "[+] Base directory: $baseDir" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "[+] Process log: $processLog" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "[+] File log: $fileLog" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "[+] Artifact log: $artifactLog" -ForegroundColor Green</Data><Data Name='ScriptBlockId'>b0e774f6-a670-4dba-9e7e-db029db157fe</Data><Data Name='Path'>C:\Users\MLATech\Desktop\ticket4_ransomware.ps1</Data></EventData></Event>
